features.title: constraints and DuckDB checkpoints
features.tldr: PK/FK consistency uses DuckDB checkpoint tables and watermarks; checkpoint persistence lifecycle has known defects.
features.summary: Current constraints feature: DuckDB stores generated PK candidates in checkpoint tables, then FK generation samples eligible rows by watermark.

features.title: correlation model
features.tldr: Current correlations are in-memory advanced methods; DuckDB-backed correlation is future design work, not current behavior.
features.summary: Correlation truth for restart: PyCore supports in-memory correlated values today; DuckDB is not yet a correlation engine and requires a first-class design spec.

features.title: DataGenerator
features.tldr: Pandas/NumPy composition root for deterministic dataframe generation, transforms, constraints, writers, and streams.
features.summary: Current DataGenerator behavior: validates specs, seeds NumPy, generates Pandas dataframes, applies transforms, wires writers/streams, and applies DuckDB-backed constraints.

features.title: method registry
features.tldr: Current method support is duplicated across validators, Pandas runtime, Spark runtime, examples, and docs; a canonical registry is future work.
features.summary: Generation method support must become a single source of truth with per-engine metadata for Pandas, Spark, advanced/correlation status, determinism, and validation.

features.title: public API
features.tldr: Supported import surface is DataGenerator, SparkGenerator, and RandSpecs; runtime version policy is unresolved.
features.summary: Current public API truth for rand-engine, including exported names, compatibility expectations, and release metadata gaps.

features.title: QA and release governance
features.tldr: Current suite passes 494 tests at 85.98% coverage; release/version/security gates need explicit restart decisions.
features.summary: Current quality and release truth from QA and DevOps audits: tests are strong, SDD was not, and release metadata/pipeline gates need normalization.

features.title: RandSpec grammar
features.tldr: Declarative dictionary grammar validated by common and advanced validators before generation.
features.summary: Current RandSpec grammar truth: common methods, advanced methods, transforms, constraints, lazy sizing, validation, and known validator/runtime drift.

features.title: SparkGenerator
features.tldr: Spark supports common methods through expressions; advanced methods are null stubs and must not be treated as implemented behavior.
features.summary: Current Spark support boundary: SparkGenerator is public, common methods are real, advanced methods are compatibility stubs until an approved release changes them.

features.title: templates and examples
features.tldr: Built-in common/advanced specs and web-server-log template are product assets that require compatibility tests.
features.summary: Current examples/templates truth: RandSpecs examples and templates are part of the user-facing value and must stay synchronized with validators/runtime.

features.title: writers and streaming
features.tldr: Batch and stream writers support file outputs, but tests must prove read-back correctness and artifact hygiene.
features.summary: Current writer truth: batch and streaming facades produce files in common formats; restart work must define correctness, cleanup, overwrite, and tmp-path policy.
